text:
Type: embossed white ceramic plant pot
Use: covering the grower pot of a houseplant on a windowsill, shelf or desk; living room, home office, kitchen
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: glossy glazed ceramic with a raised relief pattern
Colors: glossy bright white
Shape: slightly tapered round pot with a wide rim, embossed motifs such as stripes, rings or chain-like lines, compact and tidy
Feel: fresh, crisp, light, clean
Goes with: leafy green plants, light wood, white shelves and walls; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern rooms

product.name: KARDEMUMMA
product.description: Glazed; makes the plant pot waterproof.
